title: Money & currency
body:
The Uruguayan peso (UYU) floats freely; {{fact:fx-usd-uyu-40}} to 1 USD as of this check, but this moves week to week — reconfirm close to departure. US dollars are widely accepted for larger purchases (hotels, tours, some restaurants) in tourist areas, but small vendors, buses, and markets expect pesos.

Cards are widely accepted in Montevideo and Punta del Este; carry cash for Colonia's smaller shops, bus fares, and the Faro de Colonia's entrance fee. ATMs ("cajeros" — Redbanc, Banred networks) are common in all three towns.
